    push_to_registry:
        name: Push Docker image to Docker Hub
        runs-on: ubuntu-latest
        needs: [lint, tests, typecheck, image]
        # Salta este job de forma segura si no se han configurado los secretos en GitHub
        if: ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_USERNAME != '' && secrets.DOCKERHUB_TOKEN != '' }}
        permissions:
            contents: read
        steps:
            - name: Check out the repo
              uses: actions/checkout@v7

            - name: Extract metadata (tags, labels) for Docker
              id: meta
              uses: docker/metadata-action@v5
              with:
                  images: ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_USERNAME }}/healthchecks
                  tags: |
                      type=ref,event=branch
                      type=ref,event=tag
                      type=sha,prefix=sha-
                      type=raw,value=latest,enable=${{ github.ref_name == 'master' }} 

            - name: Log in to Docker Hub
              uses: docker/login-action@v3
              with:
                  username: ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_USERNAME }}
                  password: ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_TOKEN }}

            - name: Set up QEMU
              uses: docker/setup-qemu-action@v3

            - name: Set up Docker Buildx
              uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3

            # --- DOCKER SCOUT (PASO 1: Compilación de prueba local) ---
            - name: Build image locally for scanning
              uses: docker/build-push-action@v6
              with:
                  context: .
                  file: docker/Dockerfile
                  load: true
                  push: false
                  tags: healthchecks:scan-target

            # --- DOCKER SCOUT (PASO 2: Escaneo de Seguridad) ---
            - name: Run Docker Scout vulnerability analysis
              uses: docker/scout-action@v1
              with:
                  command: cves
                  image: healthchecks:scan-target
                  only-severities: critical,high  # Filtra para alertar solo sobre vulnerabilidades Críticas y Altas
                  exit-code: true                 # Hace que el pipeline falle (Fails) si encuentra riesgos no permitidos

            # --- DOCKER SCOUT (PASO 3: Compilación multi-arch y Push definitivo) ---
            - name: Build and push Docker image
              uses: docker/build-push-action@v6
              with:
                  context: .
                  file: docker/Dockerfile
                  platforms: linux/amd64,linux/arm64
                  push: true
                  tags: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.tags }}
                  labels: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.labels }}
